comment: Inject within Markdown text containers so Markdown establishes block and inline structure before srmd selects individual tokens. Headings are excluded: srmd syntax is literal text there.
injectionSelector: L:text.html.markdown (meta.paragraph | markup.table | markup.bold | markup.italic | markup.strikethrough | string.other.link.title) - (markup.raw | markup.inline.raw | markup.fenced_code | meta.embedded | meta.tag | comment | string.quoted | markup.underline.link)

patterns.comment: Markdown's bundled escape rule omits colon and less-than, both of which can start srmd markers.
patterns.name: constant.character.escape.markdown

cloze-markers.comment: Select each complete opener or closer without tracking cloze contents or pairing markers. Implicit openers require whitespace or a line ending.
cloze-markers.name: punctuation.definition.srmd.markdown

card-references.comment: Select a whole card reference, unless a backslash escapes its bracket or it labels a definition. The parser determines which card it belongs to.
card-references.name: comment.other.card-reference.srmd.markdown

card-definitions.comment: Select an entire single-line card definition, its state and up to eight further fields, including definitions after Markdown quote/list prefixes (\G).
card-definitions.name: comment.line.card-definition.srmd.markdown
